# The model census — 50 families, 34 orgs, 33 labs, 10 countries

**Generated by `scripts/model_census.py`. Do not hand-edit — the mapping
lives in that file and this is its output.** The org→country mapping is
AUTHORED; three entries are RH's rulings rather than lookups (LLM360,
RWKV, bigscience) and the producer's docstring states them.

## THE NUMBERS, AS DERIVED

    model families (endpoint bases)   50
    HuggingFace orgs                  34
    LABS                              33   two orgs are mirrors
    countries                         10   plus `none` on 2 orgs

**Write 33 labs, not 34.** `huggyllama` re-uploads Meta's LLaMA-1 and Meta
is separately present as `meta-llama`; `gl198976` mirrors MosaicML's MPT,
whose own repo is gone. 34 is the count of org strings.

**Write 10 countries, not 11**, unless `none` is being counted as an
eleventh value — which it is not, it is a decided fact about two stateless
producers (RWKV, and BigScience's membership half).

## WHAT THIS DOES NOT SETTLE

**Architecture.** `model_type` over the 50 bases gives **17 distinct**
(llama 19, gpt_neox 3, qwen2 2, qwen3 2, then singletons), and 11 configs
need `trust_remote_code` to read at all. A four-way taxonomy — dense / MoE
/ SSM-hybrid / RNN — is defensible but nobody has authored it, so **do not
write "four architectures" until it exists**; it is not derivable today.

## WHY THIS FILE EXISTS

The country of a model had been worked out by hand at least four times and
never survived, because each answer went into a transcript rather than a
file. `models.yaml` carries `country` at NODE grain — 160 to fill, 43 ever
filled — when the fact belongs to the ORG. `--check` is the completeness
gate that node-grain never had.
